intro: Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, went public today in the largest IPO ever, pricing shares at $83 and opening at $111.50, briefly reaching a $2 trillion valuation. The company's Public Benefit Foundation structure means up to $156 billion could flow to charitable causes depending on stock performance. Separately, Blue Origin secured a contract to launch Google's AI server satellites into orbit in early 2029.
